text: DDABONG Tech Infographic (heritage insert, D-058): technical architectural cutaway visualization. Neutral dark matte base (charcoal grey, no sky, no texture), one accent colour only: glowing orange-red structure lines (#FF4D1F family) tracing silhouettes, creases and section edges. Slow dolly or orbit only, museum-exhibit pacing. Diagram may materialise into a photoreal cutaway while the structure lines remain as an overlay. Zero humans. Zero in-frame text, labels or logos (all labels are edit overlays). Scale cue mandatory in the input plate (1.7 m human silhouette or dimension bar).
